_comment: Dungeons whose boss room leaves the winners in a room of its own before the way out: a room
with no fight, where an NPC offers to leave. Winning the boss room loads that room on its
cell instead of the catalogue's exit, and leaving goes out through the dungeon's own exit
(DungeonManager.WayOut) -- from the NPC's exit replies or the map panel's «Salir de la
bossRoom  the room whose win leads here
room      the post-boss room, not one of the dungeon's fight rooms
cell      where the winners stand in it
npc       the NPC that offers the way out there
replies   his replies that leave; his others keep their own behaviour

exits.why: The goblins' Akademia: after director Grunob the winners are in his office, where «De joyeux petits arbres» has them ask for Gob Ross's brush («Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez au Directeur Grunob», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar la Akademia» leaves.

Moon's tree: after Moon the winners are at the top of his tree, where «Rendez-vous avec la lune» has them offer him the moon root («Une fois le combat terminé, offrez la racine lunaire de gisengoku au Moon», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el Árbol de Moon» leaves.

Le Chuko's ship: after Le Chuko the winners are in his cabin, where «Squelettes et amulettes» has them order him to give the amulet back («Avant de sortir du donjon, parlez au Chouque», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el navío de Le Chuko» leaves.

Kardorim's crypt (PR #75, 23 October 2026): the win in his room loads the post-boss room on cell 382; his four template replies «Quitter la crypte de Kardorim» (texts 555709-555712) leave; his quest and Milimilou replies do not.

The Haunted Mansion: after Boostache the winners are in the mansion's last room [-13,-41], which «Fantômes contre fantômes» asks to discover (4149), and the chafer host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur Chafer pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Kwakwa's nest: after the Kwakwa the winners are in the nest's exit room [-4,-7] («The Kwakwa's Nest - Exit»), which «L'Ascension» asks to discover (4329), and the Kwakerback host takes them out; his «Salir» leaves.

The Kanniboul village: after Kanniboul Ebil the winners are in the village's exit room [29,9] («Kanniball Village - Exit»), which «T'as les boules» asks to discover (4113), and the kanniboul host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Lair of the Rac Queen: after Lasoberaña's fight the winners are in the lair's exit room [-6,-15], where «Arak-haï en pagaille» has her talk (9558); her «Abandonar la guarida de Lasoberaña» replies leave.

The Ancestral Domain: after the Ancestral Treechnid the winners are in the domain's exit room [-9,-14], where «Munster lève le mystère» questions him (9567), and Tronky Tranky takes them out; his «Salir del Territorio Ancestral» leaves.

The Soft Oak Clearing: after the Soft Oak the winners are in the clearing's exit room [-14,-13], where «L'art de la langue de bois» questions him (9581), and Josefa Taplana takes them out; her «Salir del claro» leaves.
